work_formula: For each actual robot block, Wpose=F_applied_float32 dot (c_after-c_before)+tau_applied_float32 dot log(R_after*R_before^T). c derives from ACTUAL link pose and unchanged localCOM, matching the actual CAD surface geometry. Never infer displacement from velocity when claiming pose work.
consistency_gate: Maximum absolute cumulative Wpose-Wvelocity <=1% of maximum absolute cumulative Wvelocity +1e-14J. Both measured work quantities and raw discrepancy must be reported. Clear both zero. No post-hoc rounding allowance added to this work gate.
reason: Body kinetic/work balance can pass despite a float32 joint position failing to advance consistently with its reported velocity. This separate pose-conjugate work check detects that gap. A moving-contact work qualification requires it as well as the existing energy and force gates.
scope: Bounded coasting diagnostic only; not an approach/tracking controller or cutting qualification.
